description:
You are a molecular biologist setting up documentation for a new pooled CRISPR knockout screen in SciNote ELN. Your lab is conducting a genome-wide knockout screen targeting KRAS-pathway genes in HCT116 colorectal cancer cells using a lentiviral sgRNA library.

Set up the complete experimental documentation with the following structure:

Project name: 'CRISPR Knockout Screen - KRAS'

Create two experiments inside this project:
1. 'sgRNA Library Synthesis' — with three tasks forming a sequential workflow: 'Oligo Design and Ordering' then 'PCR Amplification' then 'Library Cloning' (connected in this order using workflow arrows on the canvas)
2. 'Cell Line Engineering' — with two tasks: 'Lentiviral Production' then 'Cell Transduction and Selection' (connected in this order)

Add a protocol to the 'Lentiviral Production' task with at least 6 steps documenting the standard lentiviral production procedure (e.g., plasmid preparation, transfection, virus harvest, titration, etc.).

Create an inventory called 'CRISPR Screen Reagents' with the following custom columns: 'Supplier', 'Catalog Number', 'Concentration', 'Storage Temperature'. Add these three items to the inventory: 'Cas9 Protein (SpCas9)', 'sgRNA Library (Pooled)', 'Polybrene'.
